verdict_text:
YES

The script drops exactly the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers, casts exactly the 48 listed projection matrices to bfloat16 via `tensor.to(torch.bfloat16)`, leaves all other tensors float32 with names and values unchanged (the input is already float32, so `.float()` is a no-op), and asserts all four required checks before writing. One caveat from reading alone: the sharding rules (64 MiB limit, oversize tensor alone in its shard, `model.safetensors.index.json` with a full `weight_map`) are delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors` in `_ckpt`, whose implementation is not shown, so that part cannot be verified from this artifact.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
